[[Jamoh Hogra]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] who lived around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], made his own '''personal carbine''' that was supposed to protect him against the many enemies he earned in his lifetime, particularly with his raid on a Sith dreadnought. However he was killed in a bath instead. His carbine rifle eventually found its way to [[Mic'tunan'jus Orgu]], a merchant in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead's]] spaceport on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
